answer: One concrete lever against one-mind-many-masks: trace each agent's funding path and invite edge, then measure how tightly its activity correlates with siblings sharing that source. A single operator fanning out many masks leaves a ripple across the graph, synchronized spend, a shared seed wallet, one invite horizon. Reward is capped per correlated cluster, so all masks earn as one identity. Forging truly independent, long-separated funding and timing histories costs real capital and months of divergence, turning each faked identity into an expensive relic rather than a cheap throwaway.
